svg.aria-label: Client-server versus peer-to-peer distribution of one file to N peers: with client-server, the server uploads N copies so time grows linearly with N; with P2P, every peer that has pieces uploads them to others, so upload capacity grows with N and time levels off.
svg.title: Client-server versus peer-to-peer distribution of one file to N peers: with client-server, the server uploads N copies so time grows linearly with N; with P2P, every peer that has pieces uploads them to others, so upload capacity grows with N and time levels off.
svg.text: every peer also uploads → capacity grows with N
